papers.title_en: SWAP: Test-Time Steerable Humanoid Whole-Body Collision Avoidance
papers.authors: Zeji Yi, Guanqi He, Xiaofeng Guo, Guannan Qu, Pieter Abbeel, Yan Duan, Karen Liu, Guanya Shi
papers.evidence: 人形机器人在拥挤环境中的全身导航避障
papers.tldr: 在人本环境中，人形机器人必须协调全身动作，在狭窄拥挤空间避障并保持动态平衡；同一障碍往往存在多种有效绕行方式，单一确定性策略难以兼顾。SWAP采用分层框架，由感知条件扩散策略提出多模态避障动作，再由全身强化学习控制器跟踪并稳定身体。训练时利用回溯标注高效构造无碰撞监督，部署时通过蒙特卡洛采样按任务目标引导动作选择。仿真和Unitree G1实机结果显示，该方法能可靠应对静态与动态障碍，且目标奖励平均提升34%，为可定制的全身避障提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning.   Experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid show reliable avoidance with static and dynamic obstacles. Test-time steering further enables customization, improving targeted rewards (e.g., speed, orientation, or posture) by 34% on average while maintaining a high collision avoidance rate. Together, these results support a practical solution to humanoid whole-body collision avoidance with test-time steerability. Project website: https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/

papers.title_en: NeoWorld-3: From Pixels to Code-Defined Physical Worlds
papers.authors: Eachen Soong, Zijian Niu, Haoran Xu, Yihong Dong, Yunbo Wang, Xiaokang Yang
papers.evidence: 从视觉观测重建可交互、可仿真的三维物理世界
papers.tldr: 面向仿真就绪的世界重建，现有黑箱三维生成虽追求视觉逼真，却难以提供可靠的物理交互能力。NeoWorld-3将世界表示为可调、可执行的程序，借助NeoSDK构建与验证几何和物理属性，并由NeoMCP让视觉语言智能体通过工具调用检查、修改和迭代程序。分层协调器—工作器架构支持从可动单体到复杂组合场景的扩展。基准评测显示，该框架在几何保真度和物理就绪性上达到领先水平，且仿真中规划的操作轨迹可零样本迁移至实体双臂机器人执行，打通真实—仿真—真实闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-ready world reconstruction demands physical interactivity beyond visual realism, which existing black-box 3D generation fails to deliver. We present NeoWorld-3, a coding-agent framework that reconstructs interactive 3D worlds from visual observations via tunable, executable programs. At its core, NeoSDK provides the underlying computational engine for low-level geometries, part composition, differentiable parameter refinement, and physics validation. At the same time, NeoMCP exposes these capabilities as structured, tool-callable APIs for vision-language agents to visually inspect, edit code, and iteratively refine programs. Through a hierarchical coordinator-worker architecture, the framework scales seamlessly from standalone articulated objects to complex compositional scenes. Evaluations across object-level and scene-level reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that NeoWorld-3 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and physical readiness. Crucially, manipulation trajectories planned within our reconstructed twins achieve successful zero-shot execution on a physical dual-arm robot, completing the Real-Sim-Real loop.

papers.title_en: BlazeVGGT: 13x Faster VGGT at 2,000 Frames via Camera Token without Training
papers.authors: Shujun Yao, Junhui Lin, Congying Han, Tiande Guo, Ziwen Liu, Bonan Li
papers.evidence: 免训练地加速VGGT多视图重建，适配长序列输入
papers.tldr: VGGT依靠全局注意力进行多视图重建，但跨视图计算随输入帧数二次增长，长序列中的重叠观测也带来大量冗余。研究发现，相机令牌浅层反映局部视图邻域，深层逐步编码全局几何关系。BlazeVGGT据此用贪心行列式点过程挑选互补视图作为键值上下文，同时保留全部帧作为查询，无需训练即可接入预训练VGGT。在2000帧时推理约快13倍，倒角距离从0.41降至0.32，为长序列重建提供兼顾效率与精度的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention. However, the resulting all-to-all cross-view computation scales quadratically with the number of input views, making long-sequence inference particularly expensive due to substantial frame-level redundancy among highly overlapping observations. We uncover a topology-first, geometry-later evolution in VGGT camera tokens: shallow-layer tokens reliably capture local view neighborhoods, whereas deeper-layer tokens progressively encode globally organized inter-view geometry. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BlazeVGGT, a training-free framework for structure-aware frame-level key--value sparsification. At each global-attention block, BlazeVGGT constructs a view-level similarity kernel from camera-token relations and employs greedy determinantal point process inference to select a compact set of mutually complementary views. The selected views constitute the key--value context, while all input frames are retained as queries. This asymmetric attention design preserves dense per-frame predictions while eliminating redundant cross-view computation, allowing our method to be directly integrated into pretrained VGGT as a plug-and-play module without parameter updates. Its advantages become increasingly pronounced with sequence length: at 2,000 frames, BlazeVGGT achieves approximately 13$\times$ faster inference than VGGT while reducing the Chamfer Distance from 0.41 to 0.32. Extensive experiments demonstrate a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off in point-cloud reconstruction and camera-pose estimation, compatibility with existing VGGT accelerators such as FastVGGT and LiteVGGT, and transferability to VGGT-based models including StreamVGGT and PAGE-4D. Codes are publicly available at https://github.com/MagiciannnY/BlazeVGGT.git.

papers.title_en: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
papers.authors: Adam Lee, Mutian Xu, Yukang Cao, Shulin Tian, Ziwei Liu
papers.evidence: 预测灵巧操作引起的显式三维物理状态变化。
papers.tldr: 灵巧操作机器人在执行抓取与操控前，需要预判手部动作如何改变物体及场景；仅靠像素视频学习易将物体动力学、相机运动和视觉生成混在一起，点轨迹也缺少显式结构。DeXplicit先在度量三维空间预测物体中心的运动与形变，再依据预测搬运外观并渲染未来视图，使生成器专注补全不确定及新显露区域。实验在HOT3D、OakInk2和PhysTwin上显示，移动点误差较PointWorld降低27–40%，HOT3D物体保真度IoU+提升47%；两步因果生成较14B双向配置提速57倍。该方法以显式物理状态作为视频生成支架，兼顾几何一致性与生成效率，为灵巧操作世界模型提供新的分解方案。
papers.abstract_en: Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit, a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history.   Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27-40% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU+ by 47% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57x speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis.

papers.title_en: H-2DGS: Height-Field Gaussian Splatting for Sharp and Deformable Neurosurgical Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zhang Zichuan, Bart Brouwers, Rembrandt Bakker, Maud Landers, Geert-Jan Rutten, Maxime Chamberland
papers.evidence: 面向神经外科皮层的高斯表面重建
papers.tldr: 神经导航常以二维MRI呈现脑部信息，难与手术显微镜观察到的皮层表面对应；而视角有限时，常规3DGS会产生厚而模糊的透明带，遮挡内部结构。H-2DGS先集中重建并将深度融合进共享TSDF，再以曲面定向高斯表示皮层，结合高度、颜色和不透明度基协调重叠区域。五例真实手术验证显示，其多视角深度不一致较低，模型仅7.97MB，单帧渲染耗时29至42毫秒，并可由术后MRI深度驱动变形且保持外观。该方法形成清晰、可变形的表面，便于与MRI解剖、弥散束成像通路及切除腔整合展示。
papers.abstract_en: Neurosurgical navigation commonly presents magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as 2D slices, making it difficult to relate the anatomy in those slices to the cortical surface observed through the surgical microscope. We seek a common 3D visualization that combines a photorealistic reconstruction of the exposed cortex during tumor surgery with whole-brain MRI context and diffusion tractography pathways. This requires the reconstructed cortex to form a clear boundary around the brain anatomy rather than a diffuse volume that obscures internal structures. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reproduce observed views but, under limited surgical view coverage, may distribute opacity through a thick and geometrically ambiguous band. We introduce height-field 2D Gaussian Splatting (H-2DGS), a three-stage pipeline that concentrates a robust 3DGS reconstruction, fuses its depth into a shared truncated signed distance field (TSDF) surface, and represents that surface with curved, surface-oriented Gaussian primitives. Separate height, color, and opacity bases provide local geometry and appearance, while a neighbor-transition objective coordinates overlapping patches. The explicit surface further supports postoperative alignment: MRI-derived depth deforms the reconstruction, and tracked-color supervision with alternating optimization preserves its appearance. Across five real neurosurgical cases, H-2DGS gives low multi-view depth inconsistency, a compact 7.97MB representation, and interactive rendering at 29--42ms per frame. The resulting sharp, deformable surface integrates clearly with tractography and MRI anatomy, including a postoperative resection cavity.

papers.title_en: In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations
papers.authors: Hengyi Sim, Quentin Rouxel, Dennis Hong, Darwin Caldwell, Fei Chen
papers.evidence: 机器人通过世界模型预测操作对柔性物体的影响
papers.tldr: 柔性衣物形变复杂、材质差异显著，机器人仅凭局部观测难以估计完整形态并预测动作后果，而真实交互数据收集成本高。论文提出柔性物体世界模型，以变长局部点云历史进行上下文学习，生成完整状态并预测动作条件下的动态，再结合目标条件规划器合成双臂动作。仿真及真实衣物折叠实验中，模型提升了重建保真度、预测准确率与任务成功率。无需更新权重即可适应不同机器人形态、材质、衣物种类与协同模式，为通用软物体操作提供了可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.

papers.title_en: A Sparse Topometric Graph for Scalable Cross-Session Indoor Navigation
papers.authors: Eun Sun Lee, Minkyun Seo, Gwangtak Bae, Junho Kim, Seunggu Kang, Jaesik Park, Young Min Kim
papers.evidence: 以稀疏拓扑度量图支持室内机器人导航
papers.tldr: 室内环境在不同时段可能发生变化，传感器与观测视角也不尽相同，使依赖细粒度点云匹配的导航成本高、鲁棒性不足。论文提出稀疏拓扑度量图，以局部三维几何节点和表示可通行连接的距离加权边概括环境结构。学习式图匹配网络结合节点描述与邻域连通关系，在局部特征模糊、重复结构或场景变化时寻找稳定对应。跨时段点目标导航实验中，方法在 Gibson 上成功率达77.1%，在3D-FRONT场景变化下为40.0%，且内存较点级表示减少逾百倍，体现了结构化表示对可扩展、稳健导航的价值。
papers.abstract_en: A conventional embodied agent in an indoor environment builds a map by accumulating noisy real-world measurements and results from heavy inference to guide navigation. While the detailed measurements may differ due to scene changes or sensor settings, the unique topological structure of navigable passages or the connectivity between rooms may provide training-free guidance that complements local observations. We propose a sparse topometric graph as an efficient structural representation for robust indoor navigation, alleviating the need for fine-grained matching, which is computationally expensive, memory-intensive, and prone to real-world variations. The map consists of nodes that encode local 3D geometry and distance-weighted edges that capture traversable connectivity. A learned graph-matching network finds consistent subgraph structures across sessions by considering both node-level geometric descriptors and neighborhood connectivity. The holistic contextual matching is robust to local ambiguities caused by weak distinctiveness or repetitive structure, and establishes stable correspondences despite local scene changes, different sensor modalities, or limited spatial overlap. We analyze the practicality of the graph through cross-session point-goal navigation, where a goal specified in a prior reference map must be reached from an unknown initial pose in a later session. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest success rates (77.1% on Gibson and 40.0% under 3D-FRONT scene changes), while reducing memory by more than two orders of magnitude compared to point-level representations. The proposed approach further supports cross-session alignment and goal-directed navigation with strong scalability and robust real-world transfer.

papers.title_en: Relational Spatial Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Chaoran Zhu, Hengyi Wang, Chenglin Cui, Yazhe Wan, Taein Kwon, Changjae Oh
papers.evidence: 向机器人视觉语言动作模型注入三维空间理解
papers.tldr: 机器人需理解三维环境并据此执行操作，但现有视觉语言动作模型常通过与预训练三维基础模型直接对齐几何特征来注入空间能力，这会把先验变成特征空间的低秩约束，导致原有表征严重秩坍塌。本文转而对齐样本间的成对关系，而非强制逐点特征相等，在保留模型表达能力的同时融入三维空间信息。公开基准、新建空间推理基准及真实操作实验显示，该方法提升空间推理与多类操作任务的稳健表现，拓展了视觉语言动作模型的空间理解能力。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial understanding is essential for robots to perceive their surrounding environments and execute actions. Existing approaches typically encode 3D awareness into vision-language-action (VLA) models by directly aligning their representations with pre-trained 3D foundation models. However, we observe that such direct geometric feature alignment essentially exploits 3D foundation priors as a form of low-rank regularization in the feature space, resulting in severe rank collapse of the pre-trained VLA representations. In contrast, we shift the focus from enforcing point-wise equality to aligning pair-wise relationships. We propose a representation-alignment method that enables the injection of 3D spatial awareness without compromising the model's original expressivity. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks, our new spatial reasoning benchmark, and real-world manipulation scenarios demonstrate that our approach effectively incorporates 3D spatial representations into VLA reasoning, achieving robust performance and enhanced spatial awareness across diverse manipulation tasks.

papers.title_en: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zijian Wu, Jinliang Wang, Mingfeng Jiang, Zidian Lin, Ying Song, Ziqian Lu
papers.evidence: 针对无位姿三维高斯重建改进相机位姿估计
papers.tldr: 无位姿三维高斯泼溅希望摆脱运动恢复结构，直接从未标定图像重建场景，但轨迹漂移会累积，失真地图还可能反过来加剧位姿误差。CrossFit-GS 将图像序列拆成交错子集，构建两个互补子图，以未用目标帧优化的冻结子图独立校验候选位姿，并通过棋盘式验证和空间覆盖约束筛除不可靠更新。只有验证通过的位姿才会提交；轨迹稳定后，丢弃中间子图并从头训练最终场景表示。多项基准测试表明，该方法显著降低累积漂移，并改善相机位姿估计和新视角合成，为无位姿重建提供了可靠方案。
papers.abstract_en: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.

papers.title_en: OMAR: Open-World Multi-Attribute Reasoning for Scene-Conditioned Shelf Organization
papers.authors: Benedikt Kreis, Rohit Menon, Benno Wingender, Muhammad Ehsan Ullah, Nils Dengler, Maren Bennewitz
papers.evidence: 机器人依据场景属性推理并执行开放式物品整理
papers.tldr: 家庭货架整理常缺少逐步指令、已知物体词表和预设物品—容器对应关系，机器人需从不断变化的场景中推断隐含收纳规律，并处理从未见过的物品。OMAR先用视觉语言模型提出物体标签及内容、包装等属性，再经分割、深度与多视角关联构建实例级三维场景图，由大语言模型推断组织规则并排序候选位置。实验显示，其实例映射与摆放一致性优于单视角语言定位和纯几何基线。该框架无需用户明确偏好、预定义映射或类别专属训练，为开放世界自主整理提供可执行的语义与几何决策链。
papers.abstract_en: With the advent of foundation models, robots are increasingly capable of understanding and executing explicitly specified human tasks. Extending these capabilities to open-ended tasks, however, requires robots to infer appropriate actions from the observed scene. Household organization exemplifies this challenge, as robots must often act without detailed instructions, predefined object vocabularies, or known object-receptacle associations. While robots may follow instructions or learn organization preferences from demonstrations, inferring the latent organization of an occasionally changing scene and placing a novel object consistently with it remains challenging. We propose an open-world multi-attribute reasoning pipeline that grounds unknown objects across views and constructs an instance-level 3D scene graph for placement reasoning. First, a vision-language model proposes labels together with attributes such as content and packaging type, which are grounded through segmentation, depth, and multi-view association. Then, an LLM reasons over this representation to infer the latent shelf organization and rank scene-consistent object placements without explicitly user-provided preferences. The resulting placement rankings guide subsequent geometric and kinematic feasibility checks for execution. Our experimental evaluation shows that our approach leads to improved instance mapping and placement coherence over single-view language-grounding and geometry-only baselines, enabling autonomous placement of previously unseen objects without predefined object-receptacle mappings or class-specific retraining.

papers.title_en: CoGaussian: Open-Vocabulary Gaussian-based Collaborative 3D Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Om Shivam Verma, Shaya Farahmand, Lingjun Zhao, Lu Gan
papers.evidence: 融合多智能体几何与开放词汇语义，实现协同三维场景理解
papers.tldr: 协同感知可突破单个智能体的视野限制，帮助多机器人与交通系统理解更完整的场景；但既有语义占据方法依赖稠密三维体素标注，且只能识别预设类别。CoGaussian将场景表示为与基础模型对齐的稀疏三维高斯集合，用于多智能体间几何与语义信息的紧凑传递和融合。该方法在Semantic-OPV2V基准上优于现有开放词汇单体方法。研究展示了开放词汇协同场景理解的有效性，并提供兼顾表达能力与通信效率的表示方案。
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative perception enables agents to retrieve the scene semantics and geometry beyond the field of view of any individual agent. This broader scene understanding enhances transportation safety and improves efficiency in multi-robot systems. However, existing collaborative semantic occupancy methods rely on dense 3D voxel annotations and are limited to recognizing objects within a predefined set of semantic classes. To overcome these limitations, we present CoGaussian, an open-vocabulary Gaussian-based collaborative semantic occupancy prediction framework. CoGaussian represents a scene as a set of foundation model-aligned sparse 3D Gaussians, which serve as a compact representation for communicating and fusing geometric and semantic information across multiple agents. On the Semantic-OPV2V benchmark, our method outperforms existing open-vocabulary single-agent approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of open-vocabulary collaborative scene understanding.

papers.title_en: Neural Implicit Energy Optimization for LiDAR Mapping
papers.authors: Hrishikesh Viswanath, Md Ashiqur Rahman, Chi Lin, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 对稀疏噪声激光雷达输入进行神经隐式表面重建与平滑
papers.tldr: 大规模激光雷达地图通常由稀疏且含噪的观测构建，神经隐式有符号距离场虽节省存储，却容易出现表面抖动与伪影。本文将地图重建表述为神经隐式表示参数空间中的能量优化，并以等值面形状算子定义曲率正则，鼓励沿表面平滑。大规模数据集实验表明，该方法能改善表面平滑度，同时保留几何保真度，且不增加推理开销。其意义在于将经典几何表面能量先验适配到百万点级激光雷达地图。
papers.abstract_en: Neural implicit representations provide memory-efficient signed distance field (SDF) parameterizations for large-scale LiDAR scenes, but the geometry recovered from sparse and often noisy inputs carries jitter and artifacts. Classical geometric optimization techniques resolve such artifacts with surface energy functionals, whose minimizers correspond to smooth surfaces. Motivated by this principle, we formulate neural LiDAR mapping as the optimization of energy functionals over the parameter space of neural implicit representations. Specifically, we regularize the signed distance field with an energy functional defined on the shape operator of its level set, which represents the curvature of the surface, thus encouraging smoothness along the surface. This adapts classical geometric priors to the scale of million-point LiDAR maps. Experiments on large-scale datasets show reconstructions with improved smoothness at preserved geometric fidelity, and no additional inference-time cost. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}

papers.title_en: ULIFLOW: Unified Latent Human-Object Interaction Flow
papers.authors: Wenqi Cai, Chunzhi Gu, Weichen Zhou, Yawen Zou, Yijin Wei, Ran Dong, Haoran Xie, Chao Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过显式表面关系建模人体与物体交互
papers.tldr: 文本条件下生成三维人–物交互时，人体与物体各自看似合理的运动仍可能缺乏协调；传统骨架表示难以显式表达表面接触几何，往往依赖额外接触约束。ULIFlow从稀疏身体表面标记构造连续标记–物体关系，并与人体动作、物体动态共同编码。其混合变换器自编码器让关系信息参与双方重建，再以带全局进度条件的分块流式生成支持超出训练窗口的可变时长续写。实验显示，该方法提升整体生成质量与人–物协调性，并在长时程中维持连贯交互，为统一建模交互几何和运动提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned 3D human--object interaction (HOI) generation remains challenging because individually plausible human and object motions do not necessarily form a coherent interaction. We argue that a key limitation lies in conventional skeleton-based representations, which compactly describe body kinematics while leaving surface-level interaction geometry largely implicit, often requiring additional contact-specific regularizers. We propose ULIFlow, a framework that explicitly models continuous human--object relations within a unified latent space. To this end, we derive continuous marker--object relations from sparse body-surface markers and treat them as an explicit interaction modality alongside human motion and object dynamics. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) autoencoder is then designed to jointly model these heterogeneous streams while preserving their modality-specific structures. Importantly, we let the relation stream directly participate in human and object reconstruction, encouraging the shared latent representation to preserve both individual dynamics and the interaction geometry that coordinates them. To further achieve variable-length generation, we introduce a blockwise Flow Forcing scheme with global sequence-progress conditioning, enabling progressive continuation from fixed-length training windows while maintaining consistent long-horizon dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ULIFlow consistently outperforms prior work in overall generation quality and human--object coordination, while preserving coherent interactions over requested durations beyond the training horizon.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Bendpoint Formation in Octopus-Inspired Soft Continuum Arms
papers.authors: Jessica Gumowski, Julian Finn, Krishna Manaswi Digumarti, David Howard
papers.evidence: 借鉴章鱼身体机制设计可调弯曲点的软体机器人手臂
papers.tldr: 章鱼能在臂体任意位置形成弯曲点，借此完成灵巧的伸展与操作；传统单腱连续体机械臂难以灵活改变弯曲区域。研究在腱驱动软臂中集成一列可充气壳体，充气后提高局部摩擦，使腱索暂时卡止并形成新的锚定点。实验观察到受驱动段呈非恒定的钟形曲率，与章鱼臂伸展时的弯曲形态相近；选择性调节不同区域曲率可扩大工作空间并提升灵巧性。该方法以连续软臂实现自适应分区塑形，无需采用机械复杂的多段、多执行器结构。
papers.abstract_en: Octopuses exhibit a powerful form of embodied intelligence from a highly adaptable soft body. One key mechanism is the ability to instantiate bending points at any location along the arm, which enables performant and dexterous behaviours. Taking inspiration from the octopus for its dexterity, this study focuses on changing the curvature of a tendon-actuated arm by adaptively changing the anchoring end-point along the arm. An array of inflatable shells is integrated into the arm, where inflating a shell causes an increase in friction at the location, jamming the tendon and creating a temporary new anchoring point. The novel soft actuator does not break the continuity of the arm between the actuated segment and the loose segment. Experiments show that the actuated segment has a non-constant bell-shaped curvature which is comparable to that of a real octopus arm during a reaching motion. Compared to conventional single-tendon continuum manipulators, the proposed design offers an expanded workspace and enhanced dexterity through the ability to independently shape different regions of the arm through selective curvature tuning. At the same time, it avoids the mechanical complexity typically associated with multi-segment, multi-actuator systems.

papers.title_en: Geometric Algebra for Neural Networks: A Survey
papers.authors: Tao Zhong, Kaison Fong, Keqin Wang, Christine Allen-Blanchette
papers.evidence: 综述几何变换与等变神经网络，提供几何视觉模型的相关方法背景
papers.tldr: 几何学习任务常包含明确的空间对称性与多种几何实体，普通网络难以统一处理其结构。本文系统梳理几何代数神经网络，以多向量表示特征，并通过遵循代数结构的层运算实现几何变换建模及部分内建等变性。综述比较其构件、应用、实证表现和软件支持，也分析训练病态、部署约束与性能局限。证据表明其优势主要出现在对称性明确、实体类型异质的场景，而参数效率、可解释性和稠密预测方面尚缺稳定支持；因此需与调优充分的非几何代数等变基线比较，并推进代数选择、数值稳定和可复现评估。
papers.abstract_en: Geometric algebra (GA) unifies geometric primitives and transformations in a single algebraic framework. Neural networks designed around this framework often represent features as multivectors and constrain layer operations to respect the algebraic structure, enabling principled treatment of geometric transformations and, in many cases, built-in equivariance. This survey reviews geometric algebra neural networks, including their building blocks, equivariant properties, application domains, empirical performance, and software support. We provide an algebra-selection guide, an empirical comparison of GA-based and other equivariant architectures, and a failure-mode analysis covering training pathologies, deployment constraints, and performance limitations. Across the surveyed literature, the strongest evidence for GA-based architectures appears in settings with explicit geometric symmetries and heterogeneous geometric entities; evidence for broader advantages in parameter efficiency, interpretability, and dense prediction is comparatively limited and uneven. We therefore conclude that geometric algebra neural networks are not universally superior to well-tuned non-GA equivariant baselines, and outline open problems in algebra selection, numerical stability, scalable implementation, and reproducible evaluation.

papers.title_en: WovenAnchor Matcher: Specialized Intra- and Inter-Image Context Modeling for Feature Matching
papers.authors: Zhiyang Li, Ruijiang Jin, Thibaut Klenke, Yusuke Sekikawa, Nakamasa Inoue
papers.evidence: 改进跨图像特征匹配的上下文聚合建模
papers.tldr: 半稠密局部特征匹配通常先聚合上下文，再进行由粗到细的对应估计；但图内信息传播需要保留空间结构，图间信息交换则应聚焦可能的对应区域。WovenAnchor Matcher（WAM）针对这两类需求设计专用聚合：以WovenMamba先横向、再纵向传播特征，并以AnchorCrossAttention在局部代表锚点间进行跨图检索。在MegaDepth上，WAM的位姿AUC@5°为66.1，较JamMa提升2.0个AUC点。消融结果进一步支持角色专用设计对提升匹配精度的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Semi-dense local feature matching commonly aggregates contextual information before coarse-to-fine correspondence estimation. However, intra-image and inter-image aggregation serve different roles: the former should propagate spatial evidence within each image while retaining structured two-dimensional dependencies, whereas the latter should gather information from plausible corresponding regions while limiting noise from unrelated locations. We propose WovenAnchor Matcher (WAM), a semi-dense matching framework based on role-specialized context aggregation. WAM introduces two complementary operators. WovenMamba performs intra-image aggregation through horizontal-then-vertical state-space propagation, allowing vertical updates to operate on horizontally contextualized features and thereby encouraging a structured two-dimensional receptive-field bias. AnchorCrossAttention performs inter-image aggregation by using cross-attention to gather context from plausible corresponding regions across the image pair. It performs this exchange over local representative anchors that aggregate feature evidence within each window. On MegaDepth, WAM achieves 66.1 pose AUC@5$^\circ$, improving on the JamMa baseline by 2.0 AUC points under the same evaluation setup. Ablations show that removing or replacing either specialized component reduces accuracy, providing evidence that intra-image propagation and inter-image retrieval benefit from role-specific aggregation designs. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/mmaiLab/WovenAnchorMatcher.
